title: Driving Success with Yahoo Ads: A Complete Guide for Marketers

facts.fact: The author states that advertisers relying solely on Google Ads and ignoring Yahoo miss out on over 30% of their potential market (the author's own estimate, not a sourced figure).
facts.quote: you’re automatically missing out on over 30% of your potential market.

facts.fact: The page claims carousel sponsored ads can drive 2-3x higher click-through rates than single-image sponsored ads (vendor claim, no source or study given).
facts.unit: higher click-through rate vs. single-image sponsored ads
facts.quote: Carousel ads are available on desktop and mobile and can drive 2-3x higher click-through rates than single-image sponsored ads.

facts.fact: Yahoo carousel sponsored ads group three to five cards, each with an image and a caption and linking to its own landing page.
facts.quote: by grouping three to five cards together

facts.fact: Yahoo sponsored video ads are muted by default so they do not disrupt the user experience.
facts.quote: Sponsored video ads serve across desktop and mobile, and are muted by default

facts.fact: A recent study cited on the page found Yahoo native video ads drove a 50% increase in brand favorability.
facts.quote: One recent study showed that Yahoo native video ads drove a 50% increase in brand favorability

facts.fact: The same cited study found Yahoo native video ads drove a 28% increase in purchase intent.
Yahoo Mail ads have produced click-through rates as high as 4 times industry averages (vendor claim, no source given).
facts.quote: have produced click-through rates as high as 4x industry averages

facts.fact: Yahoo Mail ads appear exclusively within the email platform.
facts.quote: Yahoo Mail ads are exclusively appearing in the email platform

facts.fact: Sponsored ads on Yahoo come in four formats: single-image, carousel, native, and video.
facts.quote: Sponsored ads come in multiple formats: single-image, carousel, native, and video.

facts.fact: G2 user-reported pricing data, based on 1,357 reviews across 10 advertising products, ranks Yahoo advertising in the 32nd percentile for cost in the Search Advertising category (a lower-cost ranking per the page's interpretation).
facts.quote: based on 1,357 user reviews across 10 different advertising products
